scope: Read-only static release/build, import/output boundary, selected profile and execution contract review. No model calls or source edits. Follow-up stored-response full pipeline verification is separate.

observations.detail: Semantic evaluation overrides source but inherits bridge.advisory default mode, so a caller supplying source=SIMULATED_RESPONSE can receive source=SIMULATED_RESPONSE alongside mode=MODEL_RESPONSE_UNATTESTED / NOT_ATTESTED. The JS wrapper mirrors this. Current Arena and desktop real-response routes pass the default real-response source; the simulator uses the separate E.advisory route. No active shipping-route misclassification is asserted.
observations.action: Keep documented as API provenance follow-up; policy and question freeze unchanged.

observations.detail: Arena() direct constructor retains v50-baseline default. CLI arena/server.py explicitly selects v51.selected_profile(policy), so released CLI legacy path selects 11 questions and DRA path selects 7. Direct embedders must pass the selected profile explicitly.

Browser executionManifest cross-checks metadata and question signatures; filesystem/source hashes are checked by Python manifests and release preflight/verification, not by browser runtime cryptographic source attestation. No model authenticity is claimed.

confirmed_paths: legacy -> v51-specific-candidate (11 questions); dra -> v50-baseline (7 questions), selected in desktop host and Arena CLI
Desktop freezes binding and generated payload before async fetch; browser checks returned binding before evaluation
Python execution_manifest validates source hashes, baseline/profile fingerprints and current release selection; build preflight runs exporter --check in subprocess
New versioned builders use package-relative imports when imported and sibling imports in CLI mode; distribution outputs use explicit v5_1 names and restore temporary build_apk globals
Full builder refuses output under source tree; verifies source/app freshness, member hashes and final archive before rename
PWA/APK/embedded desktop assets are compared byte-for-byte to source copy set and generated metadata; UI/source edits require rebuild
limitations: Static review is not a fresh package build, artifact delivery test or native-device validation.
No code changes made. No model invocation.
Delivery gate independently claims local archive integrity only; source-to-app freshness is the separate verify_release/build gate.
Full-pipeline response parity and metric reprocessing are being performed separately after parent explicitly permitted locked24 inspection.
